meta.title: Tupi Battle Grounds — real-time 1v1 strategy
meta.description: Real-time 1v1 duels with automatic combat on a single BattleLine, a continuous Shop, branching Evolution and Faction Synergies.
nav.label: Sections
hero.lead: Build your BattleLine. Make your mark.
hero.text: Live duels between two players: buy units in the Shop, watch them fight on their own, evolve your champions and combine Factions until the enemy Stronghold falls.
web.pending.short: The browser version is still being prepared.
web.live.short: Right in your desktop browser, no installation.
hero.shot.alt: Real battle in the Volcanic Forge: units from both sides clash on the BattleLine, with the five-offer Shop below
hero.shot.caption: Real capture from the native Linux client · Volcanic Forge
game.title: Strategy without micromanagement
game.intro: Depth comes from what you buy, when you deploy, how you evolve and which Factions you combine.
pillar.live.title: Live 1v1 duel
pillar.live.text: Both players act at the same time and the battlefield changes in real time.
pillar.line.title: One BattleLine
pillar.line.text: No lateral movement: units advance and fight on their own along a single lane.
pillar.shop.title: Continuous Shop
pillar.shop.text: Five offers for the whole match; every purchase redraws all five. There is no preparation phase.
pillar.evolution.title: Branching Evolution
pillar.evolution.text: Each deployed unit can evolve along one of two branches and keeps its current HP percentage.
pillar.synergy.title: Faction Synergies
pillar.synergy.text: With 2 and with 4 living units of the same Faction, all of them receive bonuses.
pillar.fair.title: Fair by design
pillar.fair.text: The server decides combat, Energy, Shop, Evolution and outcomes. No pay-to-win: paid items, if any, will only ever be cosmetic.
how.title: One match, from the first deploy to the Stronghold
how.intro: Before you enter, choose your Stronghold (Treasury, Bastion, Artillery or Command) and your Arcanas. After that, everything happens live.
how.1.title: Same starting point
how.1.text: After a 3-second countdown, both players start with the same Energy and five Shop offers.
how.2.title: Buying is deploying
how.2.text: Pick an offer you can afford: the unit appears in front of your Stronghold and all five offers change.
how.3.title: Automatic combat
how.3.text: Units advance and attack on their own. Tank, DPS, Support, Ranged and Control each play a different role.
how.4.title: Evolve and combine
how.4.text: Select one of your units to evolve it. Two or four living units of one Faction activate its Synergy.
how.5.title: Save with Interest
how.5.text: Every 5 Energy you hold speeds up your regeneration by 25%, counting up to 25 Energy.
how.6.title: War Council
how.6.text: Every 60 seconds of combat the battle pauses and both players choose from the same four Augments.
how.7.title: Bring down the Stronghold
how.7.text: No clock decides the match: whoever destroys the enemy Stronghold first wins.
how.modes: Modes: Casual, Ranked, Challenge a Friend, Private Room and Practice vs Bot. Balance values are still being tested and may change.
champions.title: 82 champions in 10 Factions
champions.intro: Nine champions per Faction, each with an Archetype. New champions marked “In testing” are available in the local preview. Portraits rendered from the actual game models.
arenas.title: Eight battlefields
arenas.intro: Each Arena has one small modifier. Both sides always play under the same rules.
arenas.note: Online, the server draws the Arena for every match. In Practice vs Bot, you choose where to play.
shots.title: Real images from the game
shots.intro: Captured from the native Linux client in real Practice matches. We only cropped and resized them; nothing was painted over.
